say:2:1430311201:1.text: Of course, this miracle was bestowed by Her Majesty!
say:2:1430311201:1.source_cn: 那当然，这可是女王赐予的神奇能力！

say:3:1430311202:1.text: Can you imagine it? A patient drinks a tonic, and they heal automatically...
say:3:1430311202:1.source_cn: 你能想象吗？只需要将药水服下一会儿，病人就痊愈……
say:3:1430311202:1.male: Can you imagine it? A patient drinks a tonic, and they heal automatically...
say:3:1430311202:1.female: Can you imagine it? A patient drinks a tonic, and they heal automatically...

say:4:1430311203:1.text: Bless Her Majesty! All glory to the Queen!
say:4:1430311203:1.source_cn: 是女王拯救了我，感谢女王！
